name: Lead Follow-Up & Sales
summary: Respond to every lead in minutes, chase quotes automatically, and keep deals from going quiet.
description: Most lost sales are not lost to a competitor. They are lost to silence: a web form that sits unanswered over a weekend, a quote nobody follows up on, a missed call that never gets a callback. These automations make the first response instant and the follow-up persistent, so every inquiry gets worked whether your team is on a job, in a meeting, or asleep. When a lead replies, the sequence stops and a person takes over.
